scope: Static APK compiled-resource declarations only; no execution, network, media fetching, decryption or native edits.

facts.observation: Video Player and optional Stream Quality preferences
Separate Live Channels / Live Events and contextual channel/report/status actions
IjkVideoView declared match-parent in both dimensions
Sticky channel grid and no-channels empty state
Specific-link selection text/spinner exist, initially GONE

limits: UI declarations do not prove which view is reachable, displayed at runtime or its transition behavior.
Auto quality label does not establish adaptive bitrate algorithm or multiple actual renditions.
Most resource names are obfuscated; SDK-only resources are not assumed app features.
No source URLs, tokens, endpoint credentials or opaque protected asset payloads retained.

already_present_in_fotty.claim: Optional same-player Auto/Data Saver control exists; single-rendition streams are retained.
Existing unified source picker has grouped sources, active/error states and switching; there is no evidence to replace it with an extra link-selection step.
Playback report already seeds safe match, opaque source/option and stage context.

remaining_gaps.classification: Confirmed display mismatch when verified programme data exists
remaining_gaps.claim: Cricket channels heading always prints Programme not confirmed, independent of fresh accepted programme evidence.
remaining_gaps.recommendation: Drive programme identity/currentness from accepted registry association; retain unconfirmed only when no verified association. Do not infer a match from channel availability.

remaining_gaps.classification: Deliberate current design / product opportunity, not faulty code
remaining_gaps.claim: Data Saver is item/session-local and resets to Auto on invalidation/source replacement. A user who changes source on a weak connection must choose it again.
remaining_gaps.recommendation: Consider a device-local preferred quality intention, applied only after each new stream proves alternate renditions; never suppress fixed-quality sources or claim a bandwidth guarantee.

remaining_gaps.classification: Confirmed limited presentation contract / targeted UX improvement
remaining_gaps.claim: An empty source picker receives only a checking boolean and emits one no-supported-sources message; it cannot represent offline/provider fetch failure versus an event with no listing.
remaining_gaps.recommendation: Pass a typed existing discovery failure/empty reason into the same picker and recovery surface. Show a short retryable connection failure only when observed; no permanent health banner and no Check Streams button.

not_established: LiveNetTV bitrate adaptation or actual working channel/source count
Any business refresh logic inside protected payloads
